snippet.title: Advent NEON  - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
🚨🚨BUY IT NOW! 🚨🚨 https://store.steampowered.com/app/1528260/Advent_NEON/
After 6 years, my first solo commercial game, Advent NEON is DONE and AVAILABLE! Hope you all enjoy playing the full game as much as I did making it, and thank you all so much for the support over the years! If you're STILL on the fence about buying the game, there's a free demo that'll always be available too!

Follow on Twitter: https://twitter.com/adventneon
Presskit: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/1/folders/1i5oE9MWHNMm7FTQhIwAAQDKo9nr9b-_X

Advent NEON is a hyperactive 2D indie action platformer that's been solo-developed by CryoGX (me). While it takes inspirations from classic titles like Sonic the Hedgehog and Megaman Zero (and even DragonBall!), it has its own identity by giving the player access to a full platform fighter moveset, time-stopping and skill-based power scaling that can unleash an even stronger form for those who can earn it!

Also for some additional context: if you're seeing people mention FNF (Friday Night Funkin'), this is because I made an FNF mod back in 2021 to help make people aware of Advent NEON's existence (that, and it was just fun to do). However, the game did already exist and was announced well before then, but that FNF mod became one of the largest sources of traffic toward the game's demo at the time. "That guy from FNF" is kind of a recurring joke in the comments of anywhere I post because of this lol. 


*The game, is fun. If it's not fun, why bother?*

#CryoGX #adventneon #indiegame

Steam overview: Advent NEON is a hyperactive 2D action platformer with wicked fast attacks, omnidirectional dashing, and time-freezing! Play well enough to transform and unleash 100% power!
